newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. Palo Verde nuclear unit 1 near 80 pct power.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. Palo Verde nuclear unit 1 near 80 pct power.

text.p: The 1,221-megawatt (MW) unit 1 at the Palo Verde nuclear power plant in Wintersburg, Ariz., was back up to about 80 percent Wednesday morning, a spokesman for Arizona Public Service Co said.
The unit's turbine was taken off-line Tuesday afternoon due to a steam leak and was expected to be at 100 percent power by Thursday, he added.
"We are ramping up at the rate of about two percentage points an hour," the spokesman said. "When it hits the 90's, we plateau for some testing before heading to 100."

The Palo Verde unit was shut September 21 for regular refueling and maintenance. It began to ramp up to full power Friday and had reached 90 percent early Tuesday before the steam leak was discovered.
Palo Verde's other two 1,221-MW units were said to be operating at normal rates.

Arizona Power, a unit of Pinnacle West Capital Corp, is the plant's operator and 29.1-percent owner. Other owners include Edison International's Southern California Edison Co, El Paso Electric Co and Public Service Co of New Mexico.
